note.kid: The modem puts the parcel in a simple envelope for the phone call. Only the two modems open it.
note.nerd: PPP in HDLC-like framing: no addresses, as a call has only two ends. LCP, CHAP and IPCP set it up when the call starts.

flag.name: Flag
flag.about: Marks where a frame starts and ends in the stream of bits.

address.name: Address
address.about: Always 0xFF (everyone): a phone call has only two ends.

control.name: Control
control.about: Always 0x03: a plain frame, no numbering.

proto.about: What the frame carries: 0x0021 is an IPv4 packet; LCP, CHAP and IPCP have numbers of their own.

fcs.name: FCS
fcs.about: A check over the frame, so a crackle on the line is noticed.
